V5a.name: Stochastic persistence toy model
V5a.equation: S_{t+1} = S_t with prob p, else flip
V5a.closed_form_R: true_R(p) = 1 - H(p) where H is binary entropy

V5b.name: Nonlinear RNN (continuous, MLP reference)
V5b.equation: S_{t+1} = tanh(A * S_t + B * E_t) + noise
V5b.A_construction: rng.randn(dim, dim) * a_scale, fixed seed=42 across configs
V5b.B_construction: rng.randn(dim, dim) * b_scale, normalized to b_scale by frobenius

V5c.name: Correlated predictors (exogeneity violation sweep)
V5c.equation: S_{t+1} = S_t with prob p_persist, else flip; E_t correlated with S_t with parameter q

V5e.name: Synergy mixture (linear + XOR)
V5e.equation: with prob alpha use XOR (S_t XOR E_t); else use persistence (S_t with prob p_persist)

H1.gate_definition: Sequential cross-cell agreement: |R_pooled_at_T(model_a) - R_pooled_at_T(model_b)| across model pairs at each temperature.

H3.gate_definition: Absolute Ridge-MLP held-out R-squared gap |R^2_ridge_heldout - R^2_mlp_heldout| must fall below V5b ceiling tau_H3.
H3.threshold_source: V5b 4-config max |R^2_ridge - R^2_mlp| ceiling per statsbot D1
H3.note: R-squared (regression fit), NOT R-hat (chain-rule consistency). The mlp_vs_ridge_gap_R_pooled field is a different quantity (R-hat space, signed, architecture-pooled) used by fig3, not by H3.

H4.gate_definition: Synergy ratio (II / I_total) below tau_H4 from V5e/V5d.
H4.threshold_source: V5e plug-in MI alpha-midpoint per statsbot D2
H4.threshold_convention: synergy-positive ratio -II / I(S_next; S, E); per_cell values below are redundancy-positive (redundancy_fraction_knn) and must be negated before comparison
H4.threshold_derivation: linear interpolation at alpha = 0.5 between V5e plug-in synergy ratios at alpha = 0.4 (0.587) and alpha = 0.6 (0.852), run_v5e seeds 42/1042/2042, n_steps 20000 -> 0.7194 -> 0.72
H4.note: Redundancy-positive convention in per_cell. tau_H4 derivation re-generated by _derive_h4_threshold.py (2026-09-09); the earlier pointer to CHANGELOG v0.82.0.27 was wrong (the changelog does not contain the derivation).

H5.gate_definition: Hull-only variance fraction must be the dominant variance source vs cross-term.

H28.gate_definition: Held-out validation R^2 falls within insample CI; out-of-sample generalization gate.

H50.gate_definition: Order-sensitivity: |delta_r2_internal| < 0.05 in canonical ordering vs reverse ordering.

H51.gate_definition: Reverse-ordering interaction: |II_fraction| < 0.05 (both linear and kNN forms).
